body.p: The pigeon used to have a long beak like the egret. He lived close to the lagoons where he could get fish. One day the pigeon and the heron decided to go fishing together. The pigeon's horse was very fast while the heron's horse was slow. The pigeon made fun of his companion's horse so they decided to separate and see who could get to the lagoon first. The egret had been fishing for a long time when the pigeon arrived. The pigeon started fishing immediately and he was in such a hurry that he broke his beak on the first fish he caught. He did not know what to do. He went to the forest and repaired his beak with wild beans (poroto del monte in Spanish). Since that time he has not fished, but has lived in the forest eating fruits and insects.
